📢 JOB OPPORTUNITIES | MULTI TASKING STAFF (MTS)

Two different schools in Goa are inviting applications for the post of Multi Tasking Staff (MTS) on a regular basis.

📍 1. Jamiya-E-Maqbuliya Urdu High School
Location: Bethoda, Ponda
• Qualification: Class 10th pass
• Employment Type: Regular
• In-service candidates must apply through the proper channel.
• Submit bio-data, application, testimonials, valid Residence Certificate, Employment Registration and other relevant certificates to the Chairman within 7 days.

📍 2. St. Thomas Girls’ High School
Location: Aldona, Bardez
• Vacancies: 2
• Qualification: SSC pass
• Experience: Minimum 1 year of working experience.
• Apply with a handwritten application, resume, Employment Card, Residence Certificate, Birth Certificate and relevant documents within 15 days.

📌 Important: Both are separate school recruitment notifications with different eligibility requirements and application deadlines. Candidates are advised to check the respective requirements carefully before applying.

💬 COMMENT “MTS along with the school name” if you are interested in these opportunities and share this post with someone who may be eligible!

Source: Navhind Times | 05 November 2026
